issue_context.title: async_upnp_client.ssdp - An invalid argument was supplied
issue_context.body:
### The problem

After upgrading to 2021.9.x - started receiving these errors every (1) minute:

```
2021-09-12 19:30:18 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant] Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "d:\homeassistant\lib\site-packages\async_upnp_client\search.py", line 80, in _async_on_connect
    await self.async_connect_callback()
  File "d:\homeassistant\lib\site-packages\homeassistant\components\ssdp\__init__.py", line 213, in async_scan
    listener.async_search()
  File "d:\homeassistant\lib\site-packages\async_upnp_client\search.py", line 62, in async_search
    assert self._transport is not None
AssertionError
2021-09-12 19:30:18 ERROR (MainThread) [async_upnp_client.ssdp] Received error: [WinError 10022] An invalid argument was supplied, transport: <_ProactorDatagramTransport fd=1840 read=<_OverlappedFuture pending overlapped=<pending, 0x1c1e1dd6310> cb=[_ProactorDatagramTransport._loop_reading()]>>
2021-09-12 19:31:18 ERROR (MainThread) [async_upnp_client.ssdp] Received error: [WinError 10022] An invalid argument was supplied, transport: <_ProactorDatagramTransport fd=1840 read=<_OverlappedFuture pending overlapped=<pending, 0x1c1e1dd6310> cb=[_ProactorDatagramTransport._loop_reading()]>>
2021-09-12 19:32:18 ERROR (MainThread) [async_upnp_client.ssdp] Received error: [WinError 10022] An invalid argument was supplied, transport: <_ProactorDatagramTransport fd=1840 read=<_OverlappedFuture pending overlapped=<pending, 0x1c1e1dd6310> cb=[_ProactorDatagramTransport._loop_reading()]>>
2021-09-12 19:33:18 ERROR (MainThread) [async_upnp_client.ssdp] Received error: [WinError 10022] An invalid argument was supplied, transport: <_ProactorDatagramTransport fd=1840 read=<_OverlappedFuture pending overlapped=<pending, 0x1c1e1dd6310> cb=[_ProactorDatagramTransport._loop_reading()]>>
2021-09-12 19:34:18 ERROR (MainThread) [async_upnp_client.ssdp] Received error: [WinError 10022] An invalid argument was supplied, transport: <_ProactorDatagramTransport fd=1840 read=<_OverlappedFuture pending overlapped=<pending, 0x1c1e1dd6310> cb=[_ProactorDatagramTransport._loop_reading()]>>
```

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.9

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2021.8.x

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

upnp ssdp

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/upnp/
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/ssdp/

_No response_

_No response_

comments:
Hi @StevenLooman,

I see this issue was tagged with the ssdp integration, but probably it's also related to https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/upnp.

I was checking other issues and found your name, as I think this might be related to https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/55540

Sorry if it's not related with it, in that case please ignore.
My issue was a little bit different, so I open a new one https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/57190

Thank you for this issue @MarkHofmann11. Didn't see it until @jfhenriques linked it.

Running windows, that'll require some setting up... :)
Thanks, will help test if needed.  I can copy modified files (or can manually modify them) for testing over here if/as necessary.  Appreciate it!!!

@MarkHofmann11 Thank you for the offer. Can you test if the changes from https://github.com/StevenLooman/async_upnp_client/pull/101/files do fix the `[WinError 10022]` for you? I.e., apply the edits from that PR to your local files and see if this solves the problem.

Note that the traceback before the `ERROR` is (probably) not fixed with these changes.

Looks like you nailed it.  I just made your modifications to the files here and it stopped the 1st error, but still getting the traceback errors every 1 minute:

```
2021-10-11 18:22:49 ERROR (MainThread) [async_upnp_client.ssdp] Received error: [WinError 10014] The system detected an invalid pointer address in attempting to use a pointer argument in a call, transport: <_ProactorDatagramTransport fd=2856 read=<_OverlappedFuture pending overlapped=<pending, 0x1d93797db80> cb=[_ProactorDatagramTransport._loop_reading()]>>
2021-10-11 18:23:49 ERROR (MainThread) [async_upnp_client.ssdp] Received error: [WinError 10014] The system detected an invalid pointer address in attempting to use a pointer argument in a call, transport: <_ProactorDatagramTransport fd=2856 read=<_OverlappedFuture pending overlapped=<pending, 0x1d93797db80> cb=[_ProactorDatagramTransport._loop_reading()]>>
```

Looks like the error is 10014 vs 10022 after changes.
Thank you for testing Mark. I'll see if I can find out what is wrong (seems something internal.)
No problem, happy to help.  Just send me a note and will modify and test again.  Thanks!

I've tried reproducing this with the fixes from https://github.com/StevenLooman/async_upnp_client/pull/101, but I'm not having any luck.

Can you give some more details about your setup? The test machine I'm using runs an updated Windows 10. No firewall other than the default Windows Defender Firewall.

Also, can you enable logging by adding this to your `configuration.yaml` file:
```
logger:
  default: warning
  logs:
    homeassistant.components.ssdp: debug
    async_upnp_client: debug
    async_upnp_client.traffic: error
```

Restart home assistant and let it run until you see the error. Please attach the logs to this issue, or mail them to me. Feel free to redact any information you deem sensitive, though addresses might be handy. Hopefully this logging will give some additional information.

Turns out the `WinError 10014` came from a 'pcap program which installed a WAN mini port driver'. The clue came from https://github.com/python-trio/trio/issues/1659, in which a VPN client was hooking into Windows networking stack, causing the same error.
